author: Ang-Li-95
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds a few functionalities for Phase2TrackerCluster1D:
- In real data, clusters from the FE board has maximum size of 8 and won't cross the chip boundary [[source](https://indico.cern.ch/event/1722075/contributions/7259312/attachments/3337606/6023898/Ian_FE_notes.pdf)]. Splitting is implemented for cluster with size larger than the maximum size of cross the chip boundary.
- A new module `Phase2TrackerClusterMerger.cc` is added, together with the `Phase2TrackerClusterMergerAlgorithm.h`, to merge clusters from the FE, in case they are adjacent. 
- The cluster merger can skip bad channels, such that two clusters separated by a given number of bad channels can be merged. The number of bad channels is configurable.

#### PR validation:

The resulting cluster after the splitting and merging is compared with the original cluster. Split + merge reproduce the original cluster with no descrepancies observed.
